purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century pathology, forensic microscopy, botanical histology, teaching-collection, and Busk bryozoan slide nodes recovered through deep multilingual search.
guards: Keep original preparation date separate from later framing light exposure re-examination museum accession or digitisation.
Do not convert current mixed collection totals or 1875-1914 core totals into nineteenth-century slide counts without item-level filtering.
For Busk query the 1899 accession series by media kind before counting; non-slide specimens remain in the parent accession but outside the slide subtotal.

adapters.target: official Charite exhibition catalogue and museum object-study references for Virchow Trichina slides
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the three-slide batch, frame/presentation-sheet state, label fading, registration sticker and later 2010 re-examination as separate material-history fields.

adapters.target: official Sautermeister laboratory and microscopic-preparation collection story
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract named dated forensic preparations and their case links separately from botanical and bacteriological/medical series; connect preparation tools and microscope apparatus without treating them as slides.

adapters.target: official Histotheque collection page and collections portal
adapters.promotion_rule: Isolate 1875-1899 slides by date/person/publication; preserve old drawer versus grooved-box storage and cases where a slide is the sole surviving illustration.

adapters.target: official collection biography and event chronology
adapters.promotion_rule: Use 1884 formation and 1888 institute-made preparation additions as historical nodes; locate inventories or object records before calculating a slide subtotal.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Bryozoa collection
adapters.target: official Bryozoa collection page plus NHM Data Portal 1899.7.1 accession records
adapters.promotion_rule: Filter the 1899 Busk accession by kind of object slide and retain catalogue number donor collection event preservative locality collector and IIIF identifiers; never equate the 6000+ mixed accession with slide count.
